thread:
sophia_prod: Quick live thread from today's all-hands Q&A. Goal: capture the actionable patterns behind recent losses and surface PS/sales enablement asks. Drop very short updates.

jamie_sales: One-line summary from sales cycles: recurring asks = named migration owner, fixed-cost option for first 6 months, and a Snowflake connector.

mara_cs: Echoing that. From CS debriefs: customers cite uncertainty around "who does the migration" more than raw feature gaps.

li_cto: engineering note: we can provide a lightweight migration mode (no KV prewarm) plus a documented fallback, but PS/eng still need runbook access.

yusuf_eng: can build a "migration runbook" template. Suggest this includes: pre-flight checklist, network reqs, sample terraform snippets, rollback steps.

ben_devrel: I'll draft a one-hour "migration demo" that sales can run with a customer on a call. Repo will include Snowflake connector stub and an automated perf check. (DEVREL-204)

claire_support: Legal/Support asks: customers want example BYOK attestation language and sample audit log entries. I'll draft DOCS-556.

ops_bot: Ticket created: DEVREL-204, DOCS-556, PS-TEMPLATE-1.

sophia_prod: Proposed immediate deliverables (priority order): 1) PS engagement template (scope + named roles) 2) 1-hr migration demo repo + runbook 3) Snowflake connector example 4) BYOK/audit snippets. Agree?

jamie_sales: Agree. Add a 1-slide "migration timeline" (3 checkpoint view) for procurement.

mara_cs: Also ask for a short FAQ: "What we own vs you own during migration" so customers know responsibilities.

li_cto: timeline suggestion: migration demo + runbook draft in 7 days, PS template in 3 days, Snowflake example as a follow-on.

yusuf_eng: I'll open ENG-6010 for runbook tasks and post a CLI snippet as stopgap. Example snippet:

redwood migrate init --source snowflake --target dedicated --owner-team you@example.com

ben_devrel: sales enablement note: make sure demo has a perf script that outputs p50/p95. Sales trusts numbers they can reproduce live.

claire_support: I'll prep BYOK sample language and flag anything that needs Legal before publishing.

sophia_prod: owners so far: PS template (mara_cs + jamie_sales), demo + repo (ben_devrel), runbook/cli (yusuf_eng), BYOK/docs (claire_support). I'll create a triage epic and link all tickets.

jamie_sales: quick customer quote to add to the triage: "We needed a named owner; the SI promised to own the migration and that won the deal." — DataCorp email. I'll paste exact quote into the epic.

mara_cs: Also adding NovaHealth win signal: they specifically called out our rollout controls and a short migration plan as decisive. Will attach testimonial.

li_cto: ops note: can we offer a temporary "flat-first-month" pricing example for small pilots? Finance signoff required but helps procurement.

sophia_prod: good ask. I'll loop in finance on PRIC-17. For now, let's focus on PS template + demo. Please post one-liner status updates here as you make progress so leadership can close the loop. :white_check_mark:
